newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-FREE STATE ON LEAD OF JUST 39 VS W.P..
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FREE STATE ON LEAD OF JUST 39 VS W.P..

text.p: Free State were 205 for two, a lead of just 39 having been made to follow-on, in their Supersport series match against Western Province at Springbok Park on Sunday.

Western Province took advantage of their first innings total of 446 when their quickies Meyrick Pringle and Aubrey Martyn picked up four wickets a piece, on a track which offered them little assistance, to bowl Free State out for 280.
Gerhardus Liebenberg (90) had only extreme circumspection to blame for missing his century batting for over three hours to add just 36 runs to his overnight total.
Once Pringle claimed Liebenberg's wicket Free State's tail folded quietly, 17 runs short of the follow-on target.

Simons chose to enforce the follow-on but an opening partnership of 161 between Liebenberg and Deon Jordaan almost wiped out the Free State deficit. However, Leibenberg succumbed on 91 giving him the distinction of getting out in the 90s twice in one ay.
Western Province first innings 446 (Jacques Kallis 143, Dave Rundle 81 not out, Alan Dawson 59, Sven Koenig 52)
Bowling: Pringle 26-6-61-4, Martyn 23-5-76-4, Dawson 17-5-42-2, Rundle 14-3-59-0, Simons 10-4-29-0.
Bowling: Pringle 13-3-37-0, Martyn 13-1-29-1, Dawson 18-4-45-1, Simons 3-0-18-0, Rundle 17-4-59-0, Davids 3-0-14-0. Bonus points: Western Province 7, Free State 4.
